verdict.rationale: Users operate Buzz by @mentioning agents in plain language. The buzz-acp harness relays those prompts to the agent, which acts through the Buzz CLI. The Desktop-bundled managed agent ships a buzz-cli skill covering messaging, channels, workflows, repos and memory, and it handles natural requests such as 'create an agent' conversationally. Block's benchmark grades how agents carry out ordinary-language requests like create-channel-invite-users, which backs this capability (vendor-maintained, not independent). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, clear docs on which operations are reachable this way without an LLM provider/agent harness set up, and natural-language agent creation is gated behind owner review rather than executed directly.
